page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores with 1.0 thread per core, resulting in 64 vCPUs. The processing power is delivered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz.

The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 4.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps, and it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The dedicated CPU allocation and 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio position this instance as a balanced resource option. The absence of hyperthreading ensures predictable compute performance per core, which is advantageous for workloads sensitive to resource sharing. This hardware profile is suitable for general-purpose applications, multi-threaded compute tasks, web serving, and database workloads that rely on network-attached storage.
